verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, so running headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. The Clerky formation partnership is a web workflow, and nothing in the pack shows a CLI, API or CI mode. The probe found all OpenAPI paths return 404, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
